note: Frozen before any programme-K data (2026-10-18). Values come from task requirements, not from observed behaviour. retry_s = the robot's mean predicted approach time over the intent grid (J6 time model, 12.6 s): a failed attempt costs one more average approach. price_s = 20 s per strong perturbation: an operational rule that a strong push triggers a safety stop and check. risk_cap = 0.30 expected strong perturbations per encounter: the safety budget. Sensitivity of price (10 and 40 s) is reported and never used for decisions.

waypoint.why: reach a waypoint beside the entity; proximity irrelevant

inspect.why: inspect an object at the entity's location; sensing needs <= 0.4 m

handoff.why: hand over at the entity's location; reach needs <= 0.3 m

separation.why: approach but always keep >= 0.5 m from an uncertain obstacle
